notes.title: Let There be Music
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985022/424df360cc814ff528f23a5c16f1ee46b9378e60.png[/img]

Another big update, this time focusing on introducing music to the game, slightly changes the entire visual style and does a few other minor improvements.

[h3]Music and Sound[/h3]
[list]
[*] 12 melodies were added, that further set the mood in the different sections of the game
[*] Several sound effects were added, mainly about whip strikes and such
[*] This does not include any voices, moaning, screams, ect...
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985022/0cd272b8d0e2aa5dea2a859becc9ba54f105de4d.png[/img]

[h3]Visual Style[/h3]
The rendering and processing of images was improved to create a more realistic view. This arguably makes the game less unique but more beautiful, as the previous style didn't handle faces very well and created some lightning and color distortions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985022/e66d4cc23044cae9ed8051d1ff53f0cfb4905ace.png[/img]

[h3]Additional Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some additional images and minor dialogue were added in several places, but especially in the introduction which is no longer a simple info dump and now introduces the heroine and her "normal" life more properly.
[*] A particular brutal scene near the end that was short, is now longer and more developed
[*] A few "transitional" images were added here and there, to break up long sections of text and visualize scene transitions.
[/list]

notes.title: Sex and Punishment - Better Visuals
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985022/eec4a156a7e3c152b1ed548dd94b508da83b064b.png[/img]

This is a major update that while not changing the core game much, adds a layer of extra polish, with special focus on further improving the visuals of the sex and kink.

[h3]Movement/Animation[/h3]
A small experiment was done in the last update which is now vastly expanded, where some kink and sex scenes receive visual effects that imitate movement to make the scenes much more immersive. Some will love the result, other will be underwhelmed by it, as it falls short of having video. This is a deliberate choice because it keeps the game size on the hard drive low, and also since the animations are effects, and not movies, the VN engine handles them more naturally and the player can easily skip them or go back a step to rewatch the movement. Such effects have been implemented for most but not all sex and kink scenes.

[h3]Content changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Two new sex scenes were added with the main male character. That doesn't change much in their relationship or story - she was always available, in the current update he just casually decides to take advantage of that. Some existing scenes with him also got a visual upgrade
[*]The sex trainer was added as a minor character in a previous update. Now she's a more developed secondary character, having an image, some dialog and backstory. She also has some minor scenes playing around with the heroine
[*]The interrogator/punisher also got an image, and her whipping scene got a visual upgrade
[*]A small dream sequence was added in the intro, giving players a taste of what's expected later
[*]Dead end route is now just dead and all early choices lead to the same result. It made sense as a player choice but was conflicting with the core premise of the game that the heroine's destiny is pre-determined
[*] Epilogue on the secondary route now explicity tells the player how to get to the main one, while the epilogue on the main route got properly separated into a sex scene and a short non-sexy epilogue wrapping things up
[/list]

[h3]Bottom line[/h3]
If you've already played the game don't expect expanded story or gameplay. This is still a short BDSM-focused VN focusing on a single heroine and not much else. But do try a new playthrough if you want to experience the same story with even more and better visuals.

notes.title: Visuals and Dead Ends
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985022/b1fe63777d029a77fec1296dd9c654c006273fa0.png[/img] 
This update includes two small but relatively important changes.
[h3]Visuals[/h3]
 A few of the visuals have been slightly improved to look better, with a special focus on ensuring the heroine looks pretty. Importantly this includes the first image the players see, which will potentially create a lasting impression and is problematic if she doesn't look her best in it. Some extra experiments were done on how to render these images in a better way and the result finally felt satisfying enough to publish. Hope you enjoy it too.

[h3]Improvements to the dead end route[/h3]
 Some visual novels have a "bad ending" dead end where the hero dies and the story stops, and the player is supposed to restart. This one has a "good ending" dead end where the heroine is saved... from the rest of the game. It just felt right to have it but it seems some players are a bit too tempted to choose that. So added a few more roadblocks in their way, and also a message in the end ensuring they know there's more and better content to see by making... poor decisions.

notes.title: Pre-Release Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44985022/36469e3f10abb605a3b69844c227620bda7ee125.png[/img]


With the release date within days, it seemed the game could use some minor improvements:

[h3]Image Gallery[/h3]

Probably the biggest piece of work, the game now allows users to see which images they've collected and thus know if they've skipped a scene or two via their in-game choices. Should be a fun way to track if there's more to see by going back and trying to do things differently.

[h3]Content[/h3]

Added 4 more images, one of them is a cover for this post. And the related short scenes to slightly increase the game's content in places that needed it, without subtantially changing the story.


[h3]Fixes[/h3]

The never-ending quest to hunt typos, as well as fixing a relatively serious logic bug where one of the main choices wasn't affecting what it should.
